tldr: A mobile web app (PWA) where hikers report trail conditions and everyone sees them on a map.
Reports must work offline: they are queued on the phone and sent when signal returns.
Four phases: foundations → reporting → map & freshness → launch.
Launch goal: 200 weekly active reporters across at least 3 regions.

notes.phase-2-reporting: The form and offline sync are separate halves: the form saves a draft locally first, and the sync layer is what actually sends it.
